notes.title: [Touhou Luna Nights]100K Downloads! Thank You for Your Support! “Dash” Fixes & German Support Incl. in Update!
notes.content:
Dear players,
 
Touhou Luna Nights, which saw its final update roll out on June 15th, has officially topped 100,000 downloads!
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/cf141467679ffe57a92fb74a8cbc8e23c14594ac.gif[/img]
 
It’s thanks to the invaluable support and reviews of players like you that we were able to pass this significant milestone less than four months after the Ver. 1.0 release on February 26th. 
Thank you all so much!
 
Below we’ve got a comment received from the developers at Team Ladybug!
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/afba758722711029623f4b8e40e44b50738e63f9.jpg[/img]
 
[i]To be honest, we are truly surprised by all the support we’ve received from so many players out there. We are extremely happy to see how much players like the graphics and game systems we’ve worked so hard to create. From here on out, we will continue to strive to create games enjoyable by both children and adults alike, and we greatly appreciate your invaluable and ongoing support.
-Team Ladybug[/i]
 
Also, we’ve implemented [b]fixes for the “Dash”[/b] feature that everyone requested.
 
1) Dash now ends when the lever is in neutral
2) Dash now ends and the character dodges backward when attacking and pushing the lever left or right during Dash
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/015243e64a091ff41527729fd9fa99291aec23cb.gif[/img]
 
Finally, we’ve also implemented the German language support we promised earlier.
 
There’s a brand new mode available after clearing Boss Rush, so keep playing Touhou Luna Nights and see if you can make it all the way through!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/cc548ee0b2abc1bd8d0f9dfd7a2d011d245eb2ae.gif[/img]

notes.content:
Hi All

The Gocco of War Beta Test has successfully ended! We want to thank you all for your cooperation. 

We have now updated and released Gocco's first invasion mission, EX003.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10637068/adecf8cdbc834bbd232e643a575f153b261c1564.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10637068/9050b8a8359155177d24363710b90b695d2fb1d2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Upcoming Update: 6/6
notes.content:
Hi All 

We have a new update coming in for you all on Monday. 
Since we have been experiencing a variety of problems with file modding/hacking lately, we have had to implement some measures against it. 

Save data with illegal obtained data will no long be available. 
If you are currently equipped with items that were obtained illegally, please unequip (edit: you have to sell them) them otherwise we will not be able to help you save your save file.
You have until Monday to sort out your files.

If you find yourself getting an error upon launch, please verify your game files. 
Gocco of War → Properties → Local Files → Verify Integrity of Game Cache.

Also, we have updated the text in the Simplified Chinese Version. 

We hope that you keep enjoying the game, and we are always looking forward to more feedback on the forums.

notes.title: Gocco of War Event Announcement!
notes.content:
[h1]Exciting news!! [/h1]

Now some of you may have realised that with all the running around and questions. We were up to something. 
And we are! 

We are introducing a series of events to celebrate a variety of things! 

In the upcoming two weeks we have Gocco of War releasing on [url=http://otakumode.com/news/56dd939230692d3f75f8d9e6?utm_source=tom&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=news_feed&utm_source=twitterfeed&utm_medium=twitter]Tokyo Otaku Mode[/url] as well as Gocco heading to [url=https://www.facebook.com/1567390850246256/photos/a.1567393186912689.1073741827.1567390850246256/1567769133541761/?type=3&theater]Game Connection,[/url]where we are nominated for Best Social Game. Also, it is St. Patrick's Day! There are a couple of more suprises coming, but those are secret for now, so make sure you take part in the events!

[b][h1]Now for the events![/h1][/b]
There will be three events over the next 2 weeks and participating in the events will get you a limited edition item! 

[h1]Speed Run! - March 11 to 13[/h1]
How fast can you clear quests 1-5 in Gocco of War?
[list][*]Your total clear time from quests 1-5 will be your final result. 
(eg. you clear quest 1 in 2 minutes, quest 2= 5 mins, quest 3= 6 mins, quest 4= 5 mins and quest 5= 4 mins, this brings your total to 2+5+6+5+4= 22 minutes)
[*]You have to post the screenshot of your results from each quest you do in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/346730/discussions/0/405694115200987935/]Speed Run thread[/url]
[*]Shortcuts are not allowed
Please try clear it normally and get the time bonuses from clearing the monsters in the area
[*]Please do this speed run challenge solo
[*]Please play on easy mode
[/list]
Everyone who participates in the Speed Run event will be receiving the following item in-game! 
[img=https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/playism/NOT-PLAYISM/Gocco/hoody1-blue.jpg][img=https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/playism/NOT-PLAYISM/Gocco/hoody2-blue.jpg]

[h1]Take out Fran! - March 14 to 16[/h1]
How many times can you take out Fran?
[list][*]In Quests 14, 15 and 16 you have to try and take out Fran as many times as you can. 
[*]Each time you beat Fran, please take a screenshot and post it in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/346730/discussions/0/405694115213142724/]Take out Fran[/url] thread
[*]Please do this one in either teams, or if you are brave, solo. 
But, you can't be the same team each time, someone has to change each time. 
[*]The person who posts the screenshot in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/346730/discussions/0/405694115213142724/]thread[/url] will get a point. So each member of the team should post their own screenshots. We will count the points to determine the winner.
[*]You can play at any difficulty you like! 
[/list]
Everyone who participates in the Take out Fran event will be receiving the following item in-game! 
[img=https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/playism/NOT-PLAYISM/Gocco/hammer-blue.jpg]

[h1]Fashion Show! - March 17 to 25[/h1]
Show us your fashion sense! 
[list][*]You have to be wearing at least one thing that is green
[*]Post screenshots in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/346730/discussions/0/385428458164317405/]Fashion Show thread[/url] and we will choose a winner! 
[/list]
Everyone who participates in the Fashion Show event will be receiving the following item in-game! 
[img=https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/playism/NOT-PLAYISM/Gocco/hat-blue.png]

Once we complete all the competitions, we will be announcing the winners for each category, who will be receiving a [b]very special item![/b]

I hope you join in the competitions and aim for victory!! 

For more detailed questions, please ask in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/346730/discussions/0/405693392929676575/]Event Questions thread![/url]

notes.title: Gocco of War Updates - 22/12
notes.content:
Hi all

Firstly I want to say thank you to all the amazing beta testers that helped us to get this update out! We hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoyed breaking it... 

[h1]Here's whats new! [/h1]
[list][*]Rare monsters will now appear in quests 01-08, 10-19.
Rare monsters appear during the quest before it is beaten.
Defeat a rare monster and it may drop a new Material Item.
[*]Added Costume Recipes.
Added recipes for costumes which can be dyed. New Material Items can be found and synthesized to make them. 
Some of them are also for sale at the shop. 
[*]Added option for changing the color of dyed costume. 
Equip a dyed costume and select "Change Appearance", page 2. 
You can select a different color for each part of the costume. 
[*]Added new visuals for the online lobby.
Create lobby > lobby visual > Labs
Create lobby > lobby visual > Winter
Create lobby > lobby visual > New Year
[*]Lobby creation connection permissions now set to "Worldwide" by default. 
Lobby search filter is now set to "Not Specified" by default. 
[/list]

[h1]Attended to a number of User Requests[/h1]
[list][*]"Quest beaten" mark displays according to difficulty setting.
[*]"Clear all Quests all difficulties" Steam Achievement Stats have been fixed.. 
[*]Added a page displaying all badge parameters
[*]Added a feature for raising costume ranking
[*]Badges obtained by beating quests will remain in the chat-log
[*]Currently equipped items now displayed in red
[*]Enemy elemental strength is indicated above their HP gauge
TIPS: Attack with the enemy's elemental weakness for increased damage. 
Fire > Lightning > Water > Fire
*Some enemies do not follow this rule
*No icon is displayed for enemies with no elemental properties
[/list]

[h1]Future Updates[/h1]
These are the Final updates of 2015
----
The next updates are undecided. 
[list][*]60FPS compatibility (coming soon!)
[*]8 player quests (sorry, will take some time)
[*]Mouse Selectable UI (will take some time)
[*]User requests
Please note that is it possible some of the above will change. 
[/list]

Thank you everything for all your patience. 

In other news, a user pointed out to me that a Gocco Group has appeared on Steam. If you're interested, make sure to join it!
http://steamcommunity.com/groups/GOCCOGroup

[b]See you all online! Lets keep making Gocco of War awesome! [/b]

[img=https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/playism/NOT-PLAYISM/labs.jpg]

notes.title: Gocco Updates - fixes, plans and more
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

[h1]Fixed content for this update[/h1]

1. In "Options" we have added "User Request Settings"
The followings settings that have been requested by users have been added:
[list][*]1-1 Now the camera assist function can be turned ON/OFF
[*]1-2 We have made it possible to set the range within which clipping is applied to characters in the lobby
[*]1-3 Now the aim assist can be turned ON/OFF
[/list]
Note: We recommend that mouse users set (1-1) to OFF. 
(1-2) Sets the range for displaying characters in the lobby. If movement becomes sluggish, please reduce the character display range slightly.
(1-3) Set to OFF by default. Please select ON for assisted aim. 

2. A portion of your requested fixes are now in place. 
[list][*]Mouse response adjustment: Fixed
[*]Adjusted rate of treasure drops from enemies
[*]Changed the color of damage points to player character
[*]Adjusted time limit/people limit for some quests
[*]Added objective tag "in session" for creating a new lobby
[*]For mouse users, left click progresses conversation, right click will skip
[/list]

3. A portion of reported bugs have been fixed: 
[list][*]Issues occurring in quest 2: Fixed
[*]Issues with warp portal in quest 19: Fixed
[*]Issues with Air recovery when changing weapons: Fixed
[/list]

[h1]Important Information![/h1]
In the next update, we plan to resolve the issues with Cloud Save. Cloud saving will become possible, but we always recommend making a backup of your save data just in case!
This update is scheduled for [i]November 25th, 00:00 PST[/i]

[b]<How to create a backup>[/b]
Steam Client > Library > GOCCO OF WAR > right click and open "Properties" > Local Files > click "Browse Local Files" and copy save_data.dat to another location.


[h1]Items we wish to address for future updates (currently in planning)[/h1]

We are considering the following:
[list][*]Improving the system for equipping badges (the number of badges that can be equipped depends on the costume currently worn)
[*]Additional visuals for the lobby
[*]Adding more costumes and hairstyles
[*]Covering 60FPS (give us some time)
[/list]
Many of you have requested the option to choose a mouse UI menu. We are working on this now, please give us some time. 

Over time we plan to make further improvements to mouse + keyboard controls to make gameplay as fluid as possible


[h1]Thank you for all the help so far, we hope that you continue enjoying the game. Feel free to chat to us on the forums with any bug reports and suggestions. [/h1]
